mapper.insert: insert into course_class (name, room, begin_date, end_date, head_teacher_id, subject, create_time, update_time) values (#{name}, #{room}, #{beginDate}, #{endDate}, #{headTeacherId}, #{subject}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update course_class set name = #{name}, room = #{room}, begin_date = #{beginDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, head_teacher_id = #{headTeacherId}, subject = #{subject}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select course_class.*, employee.name as headTeacherName from course_class left join employee on course_class.head_teacher_id = employee.id
course_class.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and course_class.end_date between #{begin} and #{end}
order by course_class.update_time desc, course_class.id desc
select count(*) from student where class_id = #{id}

select course_class.name as courseClassName, count(student.id) as studentCount from course_class left join student on course_class.id = student.class_id group by course_class.id, course_class.name order by studentCount
select (case degree when 1 then '初中' when 2 then '高中' when 3 then '大专' when 4 then '本科' when 5 then '硕士' when 6 then '博士' end) as name, count(*) as value from student group by degree order by value
